title: r for five points
caption: The points (1, 2) to (5, 5) have means 3 and 4, S_xy = 6, S_xx = 10, S_yy = 6, so r = 6/√60 ≈ 0.775 and the line of best fit is y = 2.2 + 0.6x.
alt: Scatter plot of five points rising on average with the fitted line y = 2.2 + 0.6x through the mean point (3, 4).
description: The points rise on average but with scatter.
The mean point (3, 4) lies on the best-fit line.
